title: State Delta contract (P2-2 execution layer)
description: Behavioral contract for the State -> Delta -> Transition -> Motion execution layer. Lives in contracts/ (not schemas/) because it constrains system behavior, not only data shape.

identity.rule: identity is an EXPLICIT element field. It is NEVER derived from the beat-scoped 'id'. An element without 'identity' is NOT a cross-beat continuous entity.
identity.id_fallback: allowed for local render addressing ONLY; MUST NOT be used as cross-beat continuity evidence

transition_classification.transform: carried entities WITH non-zero delta (continuous state migration)
transition_classification.dissolve: semi-transparent hand-off (at least one carried entity)

continuity_rules.when: numeric value delta has zero magnitude
carried entity has no identity correspondence to previous beat end_state
carried entity moves beyond tolerance without a transform delta

temporal_requirements.note: a state change must span more than one frame; a one-frame jump is not continuity

forged_continuity_conditions: elements matched by id instead of identity
carried entity regenerated with a new id and no identity

scope.phase1: single entity, two states, growth transition, real renderer t0/t_mid/t1
scope.not_in_scope: wiring the 21-case production corpus to the new path
